main_body: steampunk street lamp / lantern post with rounded metal cap and base
top_band: grey metal elliptical cap dome with brass finial on rows 1-7 (light grey on rows 1-5, mid grey on rows 6-7)
evidence: The lamp has a rounded elliptical top cap (rows 1-7) with a brass finial in the center, followed by a darker front lip/rim (rows 8-9) and a dark overhang shadow (row 10) above the recessed glowing lantern glass (rows 11-15), post (rows 20-35), and a matching 3/4 elliptical base (rows 36-45).

style.evidence: The candidate uses a heavy near-black outline around the cap and base, creating a sticker-like appearance compared to the Beodeul references. The metal cap and base have large flat fills of solid grey with simple banded/diagonal shading and no surface texture, whereas the references have rich per-stone and per-tile shading with dark material-toned outlines.
